title: Musical instruments
examples: Teacher, how does a drum make music?
Can you show me how to make a sound with my mouth?

explain.say: Today you will learn how instruments make sounds. You hit some instruments, like a drum.
You pluck the strings of a guitar with your fingers.
You blow into some instruments, like a trumpet or a flute.
You shake some instruments, like a maraca. Beads inside it rattle.
So you can hit, pluck, blow or shake to make music.
Think about a tambourine. You can shake it, and you can hit it.

faq.q: What is the difference between blowing and shaking?
faq.a: Blowing uses air from your breath to make the sound. Shaking uses small things inside to make a rattling sound.
asks: How do I use my breath for music?

faq.q: Can I hit anything to make music?
faq.a: Yes, you can hit things like pots or drums. You need something solid to hit.

faq.q: Do all string instruments use plucking?
faq.a: No, some string instruments might be bowed, like a violin. But plucking is one way to make sound.
asks: What if I don't pluck it?

faq.q: Are there instruments that do both shaking and blowing?
faq.a: Most instruments use one main way to make sound. A tambourine can be shaken and hit.
asks: Can I blow and shake at the same time?

faq.q: How do I make a sound with my mouth?
faq.a: You can make sounds like whistling or humming. These use your breath just like blowing into a flute.
asks: Can I use my voice like an instrument?

facts: Drums are often hit with sticks or hands.
Plucking strings is done with fingers or plectrums.
Instruments like flutes require blowing air.
Shakers use beads or small objects to create sound.

quiz.say: How do you play a trumpet?
quiz.why: A trumpet makes sound when you blow air into it.

wrong.0: You hit a drum, and a trumpet needs your breath.
wrong.2: You shake a maraca, and a trumpet needs your breath.

quiz.say: How do you play a maraca?
quiz.show: Maraca: how do you play it?
quiz.why: Shaking a maraca makes the beads inside rattle.

wrong.1: You pluck strings, and a maraca has no strings.
wrong.2: You blow into a flute, and a maraca has beads inside.

quiz.say: How do you play a guitar?
quiz.why: Your fingers pluck the strings, and the strings make the sound.

wrong.0: You hit a drum, and a guitar has strings.
wrong.1: You shake a maraca, and a guitar has strings.
